SELECT enrollment.id AS enrollment_id, enrollment.parent_id, enrollment.child_id, enrollment.principal_amount, enrollment.outstanding_principal, enrollment.overdue_interest, enrollment.applied_rate, enrollment.applied_late_fee_rate, enrollment.payment_day, enrollment.paid_count, enrollment.term_months, enrollment.start_date, enrollment.maturity_date, enrollment.status, product.repayment_type FROM T_LON_ENROLL_M enrollment INNER JOIN T_LON_PROD_M product ON product.id = enrollment.loan_id WHERE enrollment.id = #{enrollmentId} AND enrollment.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'OVERDUE', 'DEFAULTED') AND enrollment.auto_transfer = TRUE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LON_REPAYHIST_H (loan_enrollment_id, transfer_id, installment_no, principal_amount, paid_principal_amount, interest_amount, paid_interest_amount, status, overdue_start_at, paid_at) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{transferId}, #{installmentNo}, #{principalAmount}, #{paidPrincipalAmount}, #{interestAmount}, #{paidInterestAmount}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('OVERDUE', 'PARTIAL') THEN #{dueDate} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE T_LON_ENROLL_M SET outstanding_principal = #{outstandingPrincipal}, overdue_interest = #{overdueInterest}, paid_count = #{paidCount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{enrollmentId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'OVERDUE', 'DEFAULTED')
